messages:
nina: Quick question — we're testing DSAR deletion flows in staging and the infra team set up ephemeral keystores and short-lived snapshots. Do we need a formal retention-exception for staging artifacts, or can we rely on the TTL+audit controls?
sam: short answer: no exception if staging artifacts are ephemeral and not customer-facing, but we need clear auditability for any deletion ops.
harper: +1. Important: even if we delete embeddings/files in staging, audit records must persist (who requested, DSAR id, proof status, deletion manifest). That may require a separate write-to-audit-store that outlives the TTL.
nina: ok good point. Current staging setup rotates keys every 24h and snapshots auto-expire after 72h. The problem is our delete pipeline currently deletes records and associated audit metadata in same job.
alex: we should split responsibilities: deletion worker erases data, audit worker writes minimal event to audit DB (immutable) BEFORE deletion. Audit events must not include PII. Fields proposed: {DSAR_ID, REQUESTER_HASH, ACTION=ERASE, RESOURCE_PATH, OPERATOR, PROOF_VERIFIED(boolean), TIMESTAMP, CORRELATION_ID}.
kate-legal: all good, but legal wants proof of requester verification stored for 1 year for disputed cases. We can store verification metadata (signed hash + verifier id) not raw docs. Also need a way to put a legal-hold to prevent purge.
harper: noted. Legal-hold should toggle retention flag on audit-store and block any auto-purge of related artifacts (including snapshots). Implementation idea: a hold table keyed by DSAR_ID that the purge job checks.
nina: question: can we keep audit-store outside staging's ephemeral KMS so it survives key rotation? i.e., audit-store encrypted with long-lived key in central KMS, while staging data uses ephemeral keys.
sam: yes — audit-store should be in central account KMS with restricted RBAC. That's standard. Staging keystores can be ephemeral. Make sure key access for audit-store has strict RBAC and requires breakglass approvals for key access.
alex: RBAC change requested: allow infra-devs to trigger staging DSAR runs but deny them access to audit-store decryption. They should only see audit metadata fields (no raw proofs). We'll open a PR to add role 'staging-dsar-runner' with only run permissions.
dsar-bot: Reminder: DSAR run requests must include proof artifact id. Bot will validate proof format but won't fetch content.
kate-legal: also ensure audit metadata includes a link to legal-proofs bucket object (s3 path) but that object should be encrypted w/ central KMS and accessible only to legal & sec for X days.
harper: one more thing — for incident/forensics we need a way to snapshot ephemeral keystores on demand (read-only) and put snapshot under legal hold. That flow must require 2-person approval and be logged.
sam: agree. We should add a small runbook for: (1) request snapshot, (2) 2 approvers sign, (3) snapshot created in central account, (4) hold set, (5) auditors notified.
nina: can someone draft the runbook? I'll update staging infra once we have audit-write-before-delete & RBAC role.
alex: I'll draft the runbook + PR for RBAC and audit schema today. I'll include example config: ```yaml
audit_write_options:
  enabled: true
  pre_delete_commit: true
  fields: [DSAR_ID,REQUESTER_HASH,ACTION,RESOURCE_PATH,OPERATOR,PROOF_REF,PROOF_VERIFIED,TIMESTAMP,CORRELATION_ID]
audit_encryption: kms://central/audit-key
staging_keystore_ttl: 24h
snapshot_ttl: 72h
```
kate-legal: please ensure `PROOF_REF` is a pointer (hash+path), not raw PII. Also add `LEGAL_HOLD=false` default.
harper: small ops concern: purge job must be idempotent and check legal_hold_table, and we should emit metric `staging_dsar_purge_attempts` with labels {status=blocked|deleted}.
dsar-bot: noted. Created issue: #4827 (staging-dsar-audit-runbook).
nina: thanks — can you @alex and @harper when the PR is ready? I want to test end-to-end in staging by EOW. :thumbsup:
alex: will do. Drafting now; will include test plan (canary run on single tenant id + verification checklist).
harper: i can help wire metrics & purge checks.
kate-legal: I'll sign off on the proof retention approach once PR links to legal-hold procedure.
sam: action items recap: alex PR for RBAC + audit schema, harper implement purge hold checks & metrics, nina update infra, kate add legal hold sign-off criteria, dsar-bot will validate proof format.
nina: perfect. Closing loop — if anyone thinks staging needs a formal retention-exception request doc, speak now; otherwise we treat it as compliant because audit-store is durable and proofs are pointers, not stored PII.
kate-legal: sounds compliant to me pending the legal-hold docs.
alex: PR in 2h.
harper: will pair with alex on tests.
nina: thanks all.
